# Hollywood Music Video Awards

| website = [https://www.hollywoodmusicvideoawards.com/ hollymusicvideoawards.com]
}}
The Hollywood Music Video Awards (HMVAs) is an annual international festival and awards ceremony held in Los Angeles, California, honoring outstanding achievement in music videos. The awards are submission-based and cover both popular and technical categories, including Music Video of the Year, Director of the Year, Producer of the Year, Best Acting, Best Cinematography, Best Editing, Best Pop and Best International.
The first ceremony was hosted by Max Goodrich and took place on April 5, 2025, with American music video, commercial and film director Dave Meyers in attendance.
